messages.subject_clean: [Rpy] rpy2-3.2.1 is released and on pypi.
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

rpy2-3.2.1 is released and on pypi.This is the first bugfix release in the
3.2.x series, and the list of changes is here:
https://rpy2.github.io/doc/v3.2.x/html/changes.html#release-3-2-1

Best,

Laurent
